QuestInfo.name: Retrieving the Union Key
QuestInfo.0: Speak with Commando Jim to trade in your Union Key for various rewards.
QuestInfo.1: Commando Jim offered to trade you great items for a Union Key once each day. Defeat Krexel to get yours today!
QuestInfo.2: You traded in your Union Key for a sweet reward.

0.0: Get me a Union Key from Krexel, and I'll make it ALL KINDS of worth your time.\nDo it every day if you want. I got the goods!

yes.0: I know it's tough, but so is Krexel! It's gonna take a lot of days to take that big nasty pile of roots down. Join in the fight!

no.0: Nothing we can't handle, of course...

1.0: Nice work out there. Here's a little something from my crew.

yes.0: Come see me again tomorrow, if you've got the guts.

item.0: You didn't bring the Union Key yet.

mob.0: You didn't kill the Capt. Latanica yet.
